summary: @servicetitan/tanstack-query-mobx preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is heavily obfuscator.io-style _0x-renamed and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the binary, then invokes it to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a ~720KB opaque, string-array-obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`, rotating constant array) with no readable identifiers and no apparent relation to the package's advertised TanStack Query + MobX integration. The pattern is an alternate-runtime dropper: a state-management library has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime at `npm install` to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle under it. Executing the obfuscated Bun bundle at install grants arbitrary code execution on the installer's host, and using Bun bypasses Node-based install-time scanners that only observe the JavaScript setup script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
